title: Mixed Event — Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness! — Episode1 Me?! A Model?!

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!
meta.Event Outline: A photographer who is a regular at the cafe asks An if she would be her bridal model. An, who cares deeply about those around her, pushes past her embarrassment and accepts. At the wedding venue, An encounters another bridal model—Shizuku.

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's see...
That should be everything I need to buy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the guy at the coffee shop just loves to talk so much. It's already this late and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow.
se_event_happiness_2022_006

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Vivi!
You look good today.

rows.Speaker: Vivi
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. And as adorable as ever!
C'mere you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...
se_event_happiness_2022_002

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've been seeing so many trucks on the road today... Be careful not to hit by one, okay, Vivi?

rows.Speaker: Vivi
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's what I wanna hear.
Anyway, I gotta get going. Later!

rows.Speaker: Truck Driver
rows.Line:
Hey!
You guys finished loading everything?!

rows.Speaker: Vivi
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Truck Driver
rows.Line: Hm? Did something move by the bed just now...?

rows.Speaker: Truck Driver
rows.Line:
Or it could just be my imagination.
Alright, I'm heading out!!

rows.Speaker: Vivi
rows.Line: Meow...?
se_event_happiness_2022_003
se_event_happiness_2022_003
A few days later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! Vivi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... Not here either.
If she isn't on top of this AC unit, that just leaves...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Seriously, where'd she run off to?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to practice with Taiga today, but I ended up coming way earlier than the time we agreed to...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Since I have some time, I can warm up at the park... Oh, I know. I can try looking around Vivid Street like I did with him that other time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still don't really understand why I need to see the city to get better at singing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it's been pretty fun getting to know everyone around here.)

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Vivi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
Is that An over there?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane?
We don't have practice today... Oh, isn't this your day to practice with Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, but we're not supposed to meet for a while. What are you up to, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I was looking for a cat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A cat?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she's a stray called Vivi. You might've seen her before too, Kohane. You know, the gray tabby with dark stripes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe...
I've definitely seen cats matching that description around here before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
See?
But I haven't seen her in a while...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get that she might've moved somewhere else since she's a stray, but I've also been seeing all these trucks moving in and out because of this new shop that just opened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I hope you find her soon...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I hope so too.
Everybody around here's taken a liking to Vivi, so it just doesn't feel the same without her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, I saw some cats hanging around this place just the other day... Do the people here really like cats or something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Vivi especially since she “understands music”. Because of that, she gets treated kinda special!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean she “understands music”?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know how cats don't really like hearing loud noises? They usually scatter whenever we sing and stuff on the street, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Vivi stops and listens when someone good's singing! Otherwise, she just walks on by like nothing's happening.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, everyone does their best to get Vivi to stay and listen! As a result, they all find ways to get better and better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's why she's become known as the “cat that understands music” who's able to turn aspiring talent into fully-fledged musicians.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no way to know if she's actually listening, but it'd be pretty great if it were true, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time.
I have to get back home to help out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll let you know if I see any cats matching that description you gave!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, also... If you still have time until you're supposed to practice with Uncle Taiga, wanna stop by my place? I bought this new CD and was wondering if we could listen to it together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
In that case, I think I will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's head on over!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back!
Kohane, I'll go get the CD now... Huh?
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is someone at the counter crying...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Is it that lady...?
Do you think something happened to her?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, An, you're back.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Just in time too. Mind talking to our friend here for a bit? Based on what I was just told, she's in a tough pickle.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? You want me to talk to...?

*Sob*
What am I supposed to do?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa!
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, hold on... Ms. Kawasaki?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, An, you know her?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's a freelance photographer.
She took pictures of me when I was little and I got all dressed up for Shichi-Go-San.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ms. Kawasaki!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Huh?
A-An...! It's been so long!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I knew it was you!
What's the matter?
You sound like you're in trouble...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
That's because I am...
I'm supposed to do this big shoot the day after tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: But all of the models I had booked can't make it anymore...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A photography contest?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes...
This year's theme is “happiness”, so my idea was to take photos of a wedding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, a wedding sounds like a great idea! I helped out a little at one a while back, and really liked how the air was filled with so much warmth and kindness...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Yes, that's exactly what I want to capture! My goal is to get shots of that moment you often see during weddings when “happiness brings everybody together”.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When happiness brings everybody together...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes.
That popped into my head when I attended my friend's wedding some time ago.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: There were many guests there, including children and the elderly... All of them seemed so happy when they saw the bride and the groom together too.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
And I had this realization.
“Everybody's there to wish for their happiness.”

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: That wonderfully miraculous moment is what brought us together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see what you mean...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A place where everyone wishes for somebody's happiness... That really is wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you understand!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Which is why I started hiring some models, booking a venue and everything... Then, I received this call yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: It turns out that the modeling agency I contacted is going out of business...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Out of business?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is that true...?!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, I couldn't believe it either!
But that's just that and there's nothing I can do about it...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: I've been looking everywhere trying to get  ahold of more models, but I'm having trouble finding the right people...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that's how you ended up slumped over our counter... I remember back in the day when you used to come here whenever things weren't going so well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Hmm... I really wanna help her since I've known her since I was really little.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(What if I introduced Haruka to her...?
Oh, wait. She said she's going somewhere with Minori the day after tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Isn't there anyone out there? A photogenic model with the aura to match...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A photogenic model with the aura to match...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes.
Ideally, someone with a brilliant spark that shows just how full of life they are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A brilliant spark...? Filled to the brim with life...? Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you both looking at me like that all the sudden?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I think you're just the model who Ms. Kawasaki's looking for, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, she's right!
To think that the answer was right under my nose this entire time...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
An, please!
I need you to model for me as a bride!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?!
S-Slow down, Ms. Kawasaki!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have zero experience being a model and I've never worn any fancy dresses before!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: With my works, I value soul more than experience! And you're the very embodiment of that, An!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
So, An, I beg you!
Give me a chance to capture that moment when “happiness brings everybody together”...!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: L-Look, I appreciate you saying all this... But I mean...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's important for brides to have an air of maturity and collectedness about them, right? I honestly don't possess any of those qualities...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I've never been a model before...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: No, that's okay! This has nothing to do with experience! I want to photograph you, An!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Please!
Give me a chance to take that really heart-warming shot I'm looking for!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That reminds me of what Ms. Kawasaki told me back when she took my Shichi-Go-San pictures.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's trying to take the best shot possible, just like we're trying to put on the most amazing event ever as musicians.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Just as I'm trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND, Ms. Kawasaki's...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
Alright, I understand. I'll lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't really guarantee anything, but I'll give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An as a model for a wedding...
That means I'll get to see her dressed as a bride...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Wait, I should've noticed you sooner...!
You're An's friend, no?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Why don't you join us for this shoot?
I was also looking for people to play the part of her friends as her bridesmaids, but having an actual friend there would make it feel all the more real!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Also, you have this look about you, so, I'm sure I'll be able to take some wonderful photos! Think of it as creating some fun memories! C'mon, what do you say?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Umm... W-Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
G-Go easy on her, Ms. Kawasaki!
You're making her panic!
